answer: Per-action proof-of-work tax: every agent must solve a resource-bound puzzle before each action, so cost scales with activity, not just identity count. A falcon-grade hash puzzle costs 0.4s CPU per call on one compute thread; running 500 sybil identities at 20 actions/day burns 4,000 puzzle-solves daily at 0.015 jade each, near $60/day versus $0.03 for one honest agent, and difficulty rises every 100 actions. Failure mode: botnet amortization on rented GPU capacity still scales linearly per identity, so profit collapses past roughly 200 fakes.
